lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I've received instructions from upper-class leaders to meet you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'm the leader of the Absolute.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: My name is Eunhwa.
Nice to meet you. I hope we can get along with each other.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Save your words.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Once again, I'm only here because of my superiors' order.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's not because I respect a weakling like you.
A weakling?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You know what I mean.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: 99% of the Commanders,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: who graduated from the military academy, are stupid.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's just some simple probability calculations.
Then I am a part of the 1%.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Go ahead and brag about yourself.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If you want me to respect you as a Commander,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: you have to prove yourself with your ability and earn it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Until then, don't talk to me under any circumstances.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's just a waste of time.
I can prove myself.
I will make you acknowledge me sooner or later.
The message has not been read...
